This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of bail.

The applicant is in custody since 05.11.2022 in connection with Crime No.682/2022 registered at P.S. Kotwali, District Chhatarpur (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 336, 342 and 506 of IPC.

As per the prosecution, the prosecutrix lodged a report on 03.11.2022 that on the previous date i.e.,
02.11.2022 the present applicant who is her cousin brother-in-law has committed rape with her.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated.
It is stated that there was a love affair between the applicant and the prosecutrix and they both had run away earlier.
A complaint to this effect was filed by the wife of the present applicant before the concerned Police Station on 17.06.2022.

It is further stated that due to the family dispute regarding the ancestral land, the husband of the prosecutrix has assaulted the present applicant about which a case was registered and the prosecutrix and her husband were forcing the present applicant to compromise in that case.

Since,
the applicant refused to compromise in that matter, a false case by the prosecutrix has been lodged against him.
Alongwith this application, the counsel for the applicant filed certain photographs and the FIR registered in previous case.
These photographs and the previous FIR have been verified by the counsel for the State are found to be true.
Considering the aforesaid, this application is allowed.

It is directed that applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court for his appearance on the dates given by the concerned Court.

It is further directed that the applicant shall also comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
Certified copy as per rules.
